text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score (points of effective capacity). Dashed line: no change from the control. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval over ISO weeks of forecast initialisation time. Daylight half-hours up to 36 hours ahead. The control's April-to-June excess over BG2 is 1.35 points at D5 and 0.55 at D9.'
